_comment: not readings: --metrics-file draws the picture from these and sends no metrics blob at all. 104 and 96 are past the ramp's hot end (A26_ARC_HI 100), so the arc is filled the whole 260 deg in the red third and the CPU value is three digits, which drops the value font from 58 to 46. The real machine's numbers stay off the picture, and the panel is fed nothing.
